title: Deer waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- Belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='75' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#e8c99b'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#8b4a13'/>
  <rect x='50' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#8b4a13'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='90' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c2f0a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='90' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5c2f0a'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='48' width='10' height='16' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='42' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- Face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='46' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#e8c99b'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='33' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(-25 32 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='33' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(25 58 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='34' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f0a3a3' transform='rotate(-25 32 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f0a3a3' transform='rotate(25 58 34)'/>
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d='M38 31 L34 18 L30 22 M34 18 L38 12' stroke='#d4a05a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 31 L56 18 L60 22 M56 18 L52 12' stroke='#d4a05a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2b1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2b1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='40.8' cy='40' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50.8' cy='40' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='49' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d='M42 52 Q45 55 48 52' stroke='#3a2410' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d='M58 66 Q70 56 72 44' stroke='#b5651d' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Waving hoof/hand -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#5c2f0a'/>
  <!-- Little motion lines for wave -->
  <path d='M78 36 Q81 33 79 29' stroke='#f7d774' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 44 Q84 43 85 39' stroke='#f7d774' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='68' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#e8c99b'/>
</svg>
